issues.description: The problem statement (Part 1) asks students to add an attribute named "inscribedStudents", but the UML diagram (and thus the expected implementation/tests) uses the name "numberOfInscribedStudents". Students who follow the Part 1 text literally may choose the wrong field name and fail getter/setter or reflection-based tests expecting "numberOfInscribedStudents".
issues.suggestedFix: Update Part 1 of the problem statement to list the attribute as "numberOfInscribedStudents" (matching the UML and expected getters/setters). Alternatively, rename the UML and all expected API/tests consistently if "inscribedStudents" is intended.
